title: A Study Comparing CoQ10 Levels While Taking 3 Different Statins

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine if Pitavastatin lowers CoQ10 less than Atorvastatin or Rosuvastatin.

Posted outcomes: Changes in Plasma CoQ10 Levels. timeframe=Change from Baseline to 12 Weeks. Atorvastatin 20mg=-96.70 (±224.24); Pitavastatin 4mg=-110.42 (±136.29); Rosuvastatin 5 mg=-103.91 (±237.27)
